verdict.rationale: Grok Build documents its own OS-level sandbox (Landlock on Linux, Seatbelt on macOS). The sandbox limits what the agent process and its children can read, write, and reach on the network. Worktree sessions also run in an isolated copy of the repo. This is real sandbox isolation, not a dry-run, but the docs say nothing about a dedicated test environment kept separate from production data or services. missing for 10: documented test/staging environment separation from production data, details on sandbox configuration (allowed paths/hosts), independent hands-on corroboration of sandbox effectiveness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
